metadata.title: fix(loadtest): improve locust validation accuracy for localhost stack
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- add fixture-aware load test controls (`LOADTEST_REQUIRE_LLM_FIXTURES`, `LOADTEST_REQUIRE_OAUTH_GATEWAYS`) and log them at startup
- default gateway create URL to the compose fixture endpoint via `LOADTEST_GATEWAY_CREATE_URL`
- populate and maintain an OAuth-only gateway ID pool and use it for `/oauth/fetch-tools/{id}`
- require a real gateway `id` in create responses before update/delete follow-ups
- harden admin HTMX CRUD flows by resolving IDs from paginated list APIs before edit/delete
- include required resource `content` in admin resource create payload

## Validation
- `python3 -m py_compile tests/loadtest/locustfile.py`



---
Refs #2636
